annotation.justification: The clause is clear in its requirement that a receiver must not wait for a STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED or DATA_BLOCKED frame before sending MAX_STREAM_DATA or MAX_DATA. It explains the consequence of waiting (blocking the sender for at least a round trip), and there is no ambiguity in the normative language (MUST NOT) or in the operational implication. No alternative interpretations are reasonable.
